channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PT entra com representação contra Flávio no Senado por caso Dark Horse
item.description: The PT filed a representation with the Senate Ethics Council to investigate Flávio Bolsonaro over his involvement in funding the film Dark Horse and his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro. Based on press reports, the party challenges Flávio's previous claims, including his denial of friendship with Vorcaro. The representation calls for an independent investigation while ensuring Flávio's right to defense.

item.title: Vorcaro diz que proposta de delação se resume a pessoas do 'atual governo', sem citar financiamento de 'Dark Horse' e envolvimento com políticos
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, former Banco Master owner, stated in a deposition to the STF that his plea bargain proposal targeted only individuals from the 'current government', without mentioning 'Dark Horse' funding or involvement with other politicians. The PGR requested the dismissal of charges due to lack of concrete evidence.

item.title: Copa do Brasil: Vasco é o único time a disputar as semis de 2025 e 2026
item.description: Vasco is the only team to reach the Copa do Brasil semifinals in both 2025 and 2026, after defeating Vitória. Other teams like Cruzeiro, Corinthians, and Fluminense, who reached the semifinals in 2025, were eliminated earlier in 2026. The club will face Palmeiras in the next round.

item.title: Eleições 2026: O que faz um deputado federal?
item.description: The federal deputy is elected for four years to represent the population in the Chamber of Deputies, with duties including drafting and voting federal laws, overseeing the government, and participating in the federal budget. Their responsibilities also include proposing constitutional amendments, summoning ministers for clarifications, and taking part in parliamentary inquiries. The Chamber consists of 513 legislators distributed across the country based on each state's population.

item.title: Cury avança, Lula e Flávio empatam no 2º turno: 10 pontos da nova Quaest
item.description: The latest Quaest poll shows Lula leading with 37%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 29%. Augusto Cury emerges as the third-place candidate with 10%, surpassing figures like Renan, Caiado, and Zema. In a hypothetical second round, Lula and Flávio are technically tied.

item.title: Quaest, 1º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, cor e religião no cenário sem Pablo Marçal
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 2 shows Lula leading with 37% of first-round voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 29%. The survey, commissioned by O Globo and Globo, interviewed 2,004 people between August 30 and September 1, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja as propostas dos candidatos à Presidência para combater a violência contra a mulher
item.description: The 2026 presidential elections have brought attention to the crisis of violence against women in Brazil, with femicides on the rise. Thirteen presidential candidates have proposed specific measures to combat this issue, including support infrastructure, psychological assistance centers, and policies to protect women. This topic is especially significant given that female voters represent over half of the electorate.

item.title: VÍDEO: O que faz um governador? Entenda as funções do cargo
item.description: The governor is the head of the state Executive Power, elected for four years with the possibility of one consecutive re-election. Their responsibilities include leading state administration, coordinating secretariats, proposing budget and bills, and representing the state before the federal government. The most impactful areas in citizens' lives are security, health, education, and infrastructure.

item.title: A um mês das eleições, Lula marca evento no Planalto nesta quinta para anunciar fim da fila do INSS
item.description: One month before the 2026 elections, Lula announces on Thursday the end of the INSS queue, a campaign promise affecting 1.3 million people. The queue dropped from 3 million to 1.55 million in 2026, a 74% reduction. The government also replaced the INSS director in April, appointing Ana Cristina Viana Silveira.

item.title: Moraes, economia, bodycams e escala 6x1: veja temas da sabatina de Caiado
item.description: Caiado calls for Moraes' removal from the STF, pledges R$100 billion in spending cuts, and criticizes Lula's government. He also proposes raising the minimum age for STF justices and stricter vetting of nominees.

item.title: Senado tem maioria para votar impeachment de Moraes, diz Caiado
item.description: Former governor Ronaldo Caiado claimed that the Senate has enough majority to vote for the impeachment of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, based on alleged ties with Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro, revealed in a Federal Police report. Caiado deemed it unacceptable for Moraes to remain on the STF amid the accusations. The statement was made during a live interview on CNN Brasil.

item.title: Vasco vence Vitória mais uma vez e avança para semifinal da Copa do Brasil
item.description: Vasco defeated Vitória 2-0 in the second leg and advanced to the 2026 Copa do Brasil semifinals with an aggregate score of 3-0. Goals from Andrés Gómez and Puma Rodríguez sealed the win, and the next opponent will be Palmeiras. The Red-and-Black team secured its spot after a balanced match in which it took a crucial away goal.

item.title: Eleitora que atua em rodeios critica polarização e vota em Caiado
item.description: A voter active in rodeo events criticized political polarization and voiced support for candidate Caiado during the gathering at Barretos Arena. The rodeo venue was packed, with tickets sold out four months in advance.

item.title: PL briga por 24 vagas no Senado e reabilita bandeira anti-STF após crise de Moraes
item.description: The PL is preparing at least 24 candidates to contest the 54 Senate seats in 2026, according to recent polls. The party has rehabilitated its anti-Supreme Court stance following the institutional crisis triggered by Moraes, signaling a polarization strategy to expand its national influence.

item.title: A nova pesquisa no estado que costuma ser termômetro da eleição presidencial
item.description: A Quaest poll in Minas Gerais, traditionally a bellwether for presidential elections, will be released on September 8 and will measure voting intentions for president, governor, and Senate, including first- and second-round simulations. Candidates mentioned include Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, and Zema. The survey also gauges voter rejection rates, vote certainty, and opinions on state-specific issues.

item.title: Caiado critica uso de câmeras por policiais: “Nunca vi em campo de guerra”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PDT presidential candidate, criticized the use of body cameras by police during operations like the Rio's Operation Containment, claiming he has never seen such equipment in situations he referred to as 'police warfare'. He stated cameras are only justified in what he considers modern operations and emphasized that criminals use weapons superior to those of law enforcement.

item.title: Lula publica vídeo com críticas a Flávio: “Trabalha na escala 3 X 4”
item.description: Lula released an electoral ad criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming he 'works on a 3 X 4 scale'. The video promotes the PEC eliminating the 6 X 1 workweek, which Lula supports as a protection for workers.

item.title: Toffoli libera campanha digital e repasses do fundo eleitoral a Wilton Grassi
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli authorized digital campaigning, FEC funding, and debate participation for Wilson Grassi (Democrata), reversing a suspension issued the previous week due to delays in registering social media profiles. Toffoli emphasized that the measure ensures fairness among candidates and does not constitute a sanction, reinforcing transparency requirements for social media disclosure.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest mostra disputa Tarcísio x Haddad pelo governo de São Paulo
item.description: A new Quaest poll shows the race between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad for the governorship of São Paulo in first and second-round scenarios. The survey also measures spontaneous voting intention, candidate recognition and rejection, and includes simulations for the presidential election.

item.title: ‘Não vejo como ele pode permanecer no Supremo’, diz Caiado sobre impeachment de Alexandre de Moraes
item.description: Caiado stated that Alexandre de Moraes should not remain on the STF, referencing leaked messages, and called for impeachment. He also advocated for R$ 50 billion in budget cuts and a minimum age of 60 for Supreme Court justices.

item.title: Toffoli libera propaganda digital do candidato a presidente Grassi
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli decided to allow digital campaigning for presidential candidate Wilson Grassi (Democrata), reversing his previous suspension over unregistered social media profiles. The candidate reported eight social media profiles to the Electoral Court with a 17-day delay, but provided satisfactory clarifications, including the use of cross-posting mechanisms between Facebook and Instagram. With this decision, Grassi resumes receiving campaign funding and can participate in debates.

item.title: O cálculo de Lula, PT e STF sobre impeachment e investigação de Moraes por relação com Vorcaro
item.description: The crisis involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro places the STF in a delicate situation with potential electoral implications for President Lula's government and the PT. STF President Edson Fachin must decide whether to investigate how classified investigation information reached the banker. The episode raises impeachment risks against STF ministers and impacts the government's political strategy.

item.title: Flávio cobra posicionamento de Lula sobre Moraes: “Tem o rabo preso”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used a campaign rally in Porto Alegre to pressure Lula over leaked Moraes conversations, calling him 'cornered' and promising to lower food prices like during Bolsonaro's government.

item.title: Texto critica personalismo da presidente da EBC Antonia Pellegrino
item.description: The Ouvidoria Cidadã website of EBC published a text criticizing the company's president, Antonia Pellegrino, for a pattern of personalization in management, highlighting episodes such as celebrations on Instagram and an invitation from Google Gemini to Shakira's show. The criticism points to excessive use of personal profile for audience listening, to the detriment of institutional instances, and questions closeness with big tech companies during the tightening of rules by the federal government.

item.title: Toffoli libera Grassi a fazer campanha digital e participar de debates
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli reversed a prior decision and authorized Wilson Grassi, candidate from the Democrata party, to conduct digital campaigning, participate in debates, and access electoral fund resources. The decision enables the candidate to expand visibility and voter engagement ahead of the 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: Esse tal do Lula foi único a não se pronunciar sobre escândalo de Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes again, claiming Lula owes his third term to the judge. During a live stream, the PL candidate questioned the STF's neutrality and highlighted Moraes' influence in Brazilian politics. The remarks were made amid the campaign for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Alcolumbre sai em defesa de Moraes e cita envolvimento de Flávio Bolsonaro com Vorcaro
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre defended Alexandre de Moraes against opposition pressure, highlighting Flávio Bolsonaro's involvement with businessman Vorcaro. The Senate president rejected the opening of an impeachment process against the STF minister. The defense occurs amid political criticism regarding Moraes' performance.

item.title: Lula recebe Leonardo DiCaprio para conversa sobre mudanças climáticas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with actor and activist Leonardo DiCaprio at the Presidential Palace to discuss climate change impacts and Brazilian government environmental initiatives. The meeting emphasized Brazil's commitment to environmental preservation and collaborative actions against deforestation.

item.title: TSE valida seis registros de candidatura à Presidência; ainda faltam sete
item.description: The TSE validated six presidential candidates for the 2026 election, with review led by ministers André Mendonça and Estela Aranha. Seven candidate registrations are still pending approval. The 2026 electoral calendar continues, generating expectations about new entrants in the race.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest mostra eleição presidencial no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: A new Quaest poll, scheduled for release on September 8th, will examine the 2026 presidential election, testing a potential runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The survey will also assess gubernatorial and Senate races in São Paulo, measuring voting intentions and electoral decision-making clarity.

item.title: Alcolumbre rebate cobrança por impeachment de Moraes e cita caso Dark Horse
item.description: The President of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre, criticized the R$130 million payment requested by Daniel Vorcaro for the Dark Horse film, using the case to reinforce his stance against the impeachment requests for Alexandre de Moraes. He highlighted the hypocrisy of requesting money to produce content about Jair Bolsonaro and now attempting to incriminate Moraes for alleged irregularities. Tensions at the Supreme Federal Court have escalated after a PF report revealed dialogues between Moraes and Vorcaro.

item.title: 80 anos da Secretaria-Geral da Mesa e da Diretoria-Geral terão sessões especiais
item.description: The Senate approved special sessions to celebrate the 80th anniversary of the General Directorate and the General Secretariat of the Board. Both structures, created in 1946, are responsible for advising the Board of Directors, coordinating administrative management, and supporting the electronic legislative process. Davi Alcolumbre highlighted the work of Senate Federal servers and collaborators.

item.title: Lula intensifica campanha com 7 atos em 10 dias e foco no Sul
item.description: Lula intensifies campaign with seven events in 10 days, focusing on visits to Ceará, São Paulo, Piauí, and a tour of three rallies in the South (RS, PR, SC). The agenda includes events backing PT allies like Elmano de Freitas and Leandro Grass, while avoiding states such as Pernambuco and Maranhão, where the PT has its own candidates.

item.title: Veja como foi a quarta-feira (2) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On Wednesday (2), the presidential candidates carried out varied agendas, with highlights including Samara Martins, who met with students and workers in Rio de Janeiro, and Augusto Cury, who visited the Jewish community in São Paulo. Wilson Grassi protested against the suspension of his social media campaign by the TSE, reaffirming that his candidacy is entirely digitally funded. Other candidates, such as Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Rui Costa Pimenta, did not have public agendas disclosed.

item.title: Randolfe: votação da PEC do fim da escala 6x1 acontecerá até outubro
item.description: The government leader in Congress, Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP), stated that the vote on PEC 221/2019, which ends the 6x1 work schedule, will take place by October, following the opposition's move to block the vote in the CCJ. The allied base plans to approve the proposal before the first round of elections scheduled for October 4, or, if not possible, in the following week.

item.title: MG: Lagoa Santa recebe Campeonato Brasileiro de Canoagem com 534 atletas
item.description: Lagoa Santa, in the Metropolitan Region of Belo Horizonte, will host the 2026 Brazilian Kayak Sprint and Paracanoe Championships from September 3 to 6, featuring 534 athletes from 36 clubs across 11 states. The competition includes 260 races across youth to master categories, paracanoe events, and adaptive classes, contributing to the national ranking and future selections.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram Lula 5% pior que em 2022, aponta estrategista
item.description: Polling data from 2026 shows Lula is 5 percentage points below his 2022 performance, according to strategist Roberto Reis. Flávio Bolsonaro outperforms his father at the same stage of the race. The scenario reflects crystallized voter alignments and the incumbent effect.

item.title: Com Neymar, Santos e Palmeiras estão escalados para a Copa do Brasil
item.description: Santos and Palmeiras face each other tonight (September 2nd) at 9:30 PM at Vila Belmiro Stadium for the Copa do Brasil. With a 3-0 win from the first leg, Palmeiras can lose by up to two goals and still advance. Neymar and Gabigol are both listed in Santos' starting lineup, while Palmeiras has also announced their starting eleven.

item.title: Senado: oposição obstrui e fim da escala 6x1 não vai a plenário
item.description: The government base in the Senate decided not to send the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale to the plenary due to lack of guaranteed votes and opposition obstruction. Opposition leaders such as Rogério Marinho and Flávio Bolsonaro mobilized senators to prevent the vote, which is now expected after the first electoral round. The proposal provides for two paid rest days per week and reduces the workday from 44 to 40 hours.

item.title: Gonet pede arquivamento de denúncias de Vorcaro, que prometeu delatar ‘atual governo’
item.description: The Attorney General of the Republic, Paulo Gonet, requested the archiving of complaints made by banker Daniel Vorcaro, who claimed threats to avoid a plea bargain. Vorcaro promised to leak information about the current Lula government but provided no concrete evidence. The PGR deemed the testimony to lack sufficient veracity.

item.title: Alcolumbre responde a pedido de impeachment de Moraes por relação com Vorcaro e alfineta Flávio
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre said previous requests of R$130 million to the same individual — a reference to Flávio Bolsonaro — were not questioned, while now only Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is being targeted over alleged ties to businessman Daniel Vorcaro. Federal Police investigate million-dollar contracts between Vorcaro-linked companies and the law firm of Viviane Barci de Moraes, Moraes’ wife, as well as personal gifts provided to the justice.

item.title: Toffoli libera campanha digital do Wilson Grassi, candidato à Presidência da República
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli approved the digital campaign of Wilson Grassi, a Democrata presidential candidate, after a 3-day suspension. The ruling also enables FEFC funding and debate participation. Toffoli emphasized the legal obligation for candidates to report social media accounts to ensure transparency and fair competition.

item.title: “Alexandre é Lula e Lula é Alexandre”, diz Gaspar, vice de Flávio
item.description: Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (União Brasil-AL), running for vice-president under Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), claimed that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva act jointly to supposedly undermine Bolsonarismo. Gaspar also suggested the Banco Master scheme reaches Lula and demanded punishment for lawmakers who made unfounded corruption accusations. He also criticized the performance of Attorney General Paulo Gonet and legislators who filed charges without evidence.

item.title: O alerta para Lula em pesquisa na reta final da campanha eleitoral, segundo diretor da Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll shows Lula government disapproval reached 48%, surpassing 45% approval, signaling a warning for reelection. Quaest's intelligence director Guilherme Russo warns that declining approval favors the opposition, especially among independent voters. The campaign faces challenges to regain support, with factors like the economy and news shaping voter sentiment.

item.title: O candidato à presidência que pode ser mais prejudicado pelo caso Moraes e Vorcaro, segundo diretor da Quaest
item.description: The case involving Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro could have a negative electoral impact on President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, particularly due to his perceived political closeness to Moraes, according to an analyst from Quaest. It is expected that the episode will benefit the opposition, especially anti-system candidates.

item.title: Lula comemora aprovação de projeto que cria política para minerais críticos
item.description: President Lula celebrated the Senate approval of the bill creating the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals, aiming to boost domestic processing. The proposal includes tax incentives of up to R$5 billion and the creation of a council linked to the Presidency to drive the production chain.

item.title: A tendência favorável em pesquisa para a campanha de Flávio na eleição presidencial
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign shows growth in voting intentions for a potential second round, according to Quaest. The latest survey indicates a technical tie between Lula (42%) and Flávio (41%), with Lula losing ground and Flávio gaining strength. The race is becoming more polarized and tighter.

item.title: Veja fotos de Leonardo DiCaprio em encontro com Lula e Janja em Brasília
item.description: Leonardo DiCaprio met with President Lula and First Lady Janja at the Palácio do Planalto in Brasília to discuss environmental preservation and bioeconomy. The conversation also covered the role of women in conserving natural reserves and protecting the Amazon rainforest, with Culture Minister Margareth Menezes in attendance.

item.title: Novas tecnologias facilitam atendimento a mulheres vítimas de violência
item.description: New technologies have facilitated assistance to women victims of violence in Brazil, such as virtual assistants and electronic systems for filing police reports. In São Paulo, the virtual assistant Júlia enabled nearly 36,000 interactions since 2020, with a 15% increase in protective measure requests between 2023 and 2025. The digitization of services has also enabled assistance outside business hours, expanding access to protection.

item.title: Alcolumbre sai em defesa de ministro e rebate Flávio: ‘Agora culpado de R$ 130 milhões para filme sou eu e Moraes’
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre defended Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and criticized lawmakers pushing for his impeachment, linking the pressure to funding for a biographical film about Jair Bolsonaro. He recalled that Flávio Bolsonaro was offered R$ 130 million for the project, implying both are now 'responsible'.
